concerns.text: Phase 6 (T049-T052) introduces a 'Topological Refinement' workflow that depends on T015/T016 (US2) but is not gated by the N>=30 sample size check (T026a). If T026a fails (N<30), the pipeline halts, yet T049-T052 are listed as dependent on T015/T016 without explicitly checking T026a. This creates a risk of executing complex classification logic on insufficient data, violating the blocking nature of the sample size gate defined in SC-001.

T026a (N>=30 gate) is placed in Phase 5 (US3) and depends on T015/T016. However, T049-T052 (Phase 6) depend on T015/T016 but not T026a. If the sample size is <30, T026a halts the pipeline, but the dependency graph implies T049-T052 could theoretically be scheduled or considered 'ready' before the gate is checked, or the gate is checked too late for the topological refinement tasks which also require valid participant counts.

T048 (Memory Verification) depends on T026a (N>=30 gate) and T045. However, T027 (Streaming Data Verification) depends on T048 AND T026a. T027 is marked as [P] (parallel-safe) in the header but has a complex dependency chain on T048 which is a runtime verification task. If T048 fails (memory > 7GB), T027 cannot run. The parallel tag [P] on T027 is misleading as it cannot run until T048 completes and passes, creating a hidden sequential dependency that violates the [P] contract.

T019 (Validation of paired data) depends on T010 (Download). T020 (Correlation) depends on T019 and T026a. T026a depends on T015/T016. This creates a circular or blocked flow: T020 needs T026a (features), but T019 (validation) is a prerequisite for T020. If T010 fails validation (no paired data), T019 halts. If T015/T016 fail (no features), T026a halts. The dependency chain T020 -> T026a -> T015/T016 -> T011 -> T010 is correct, but T019 -> T020 implies T019 must run before T020. If T019 halts due to missing data, T020 never runs. This is correct, but the placement of T019 in Phase 5 alongside T020 suggests they are peers, whereas T019 is a strict gate for T020. The ordering is semantically correct but the grouping obscures the strict blocking nature of T019 on T020.

T027 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T048 (memory verification) and T026a (sample size gate). These are sequential blocking tasks. The [P] tag is incorrect as T027 cannot run in parallel with T048 or T026a; it must wait for them to complete and pass. This mislabeling could lead to scheduling errors in a parallel execution engine.
